$comment: Specialists hired into the plugin itself (hire run inside the technical-team repo), beyond the 13 core roles. Each entry: write = globs it owns (carved out of the developer's area, after .team/, docs, infra, tests, data), bash = none | readonly | developer | db-local, hookPoints and trigger tell the lead when to call it. These are the limits the lead puts in every brief and the specialist's own agent file repeats; nothing blocks a call that ignores them.
